atomic-mail-atomic-mail-agentic-docs.description: Read and write email through the Atomic Mail from an AI agent. Handles proof-of-work authentication and JMAP so the agent thinks in JMAP method calls. Use when the user asks to register an email inbox, list mailboxes, fetch or send email, or schedule meetings by email (calendar invitations).

atomic-mail-atomic-mail-agentic-integrat.description: Use the agent's own Atomic Mail inbox. Read, search, send and reply to email from the agent's @atomicmail.ai address, and schedule meetings with real calendar invitations. Use when the user asks for your email address, wants you to email someone, check your inbox, or set up, move or cancel a meeting.
